description: Lexyal is a CE-marked Korean cross-linked hyaluronic acid dermal filler used for aesthetic volumising and wrinkle correction. It is supplied in three grades - Fine, Deep and Grand - that differ in cross-linking density and firmness for progressively deeper injection planes. It is marketed as a high-purity, non-animal HA gel at about 24 mg/mL; the manufacturer is not consistently identified by distributors.
howItWorks: The cross-linked hyaluronic acid gel adds immediate volume and structural support and binds water for tissue hydration. Injection depth and indication depend on the grade's gel firmness (G-prime), from superficial lines with Fine to deep volumising with Grand.
composition: Cross-linked non-animal hyaluronic acid, approximately 24 mg/mL; offered with or without lidocaine. Marketed as a monophasic gel across the Fine/Deep/Grand grades.
usageNotes: Store per label (typically 2-8 C), protect from freezing and direct light. Inject with an appropriate needle or cannula into the plane indicated for the chosen grade. Keep hyaluronidase available for correction or vascular events, and confirm CE/registration status for your market before use.
features: Fine / Deep / Grand grades of increasing firmness
benefits: HA gel is reversible with hyaluronidase if correction is needed
Immediate, natural-looking volumising and wrinkle smoothing
Graded firmness lets clinicians match the gel to the injection plane
Non-animal HA lowers immunogenic risk

It is graded No.1 to No.4 by degree of cross-linking, from hydration and fine-line correction up to deep volumising and contouring. It is premixed with 0.3% lidocaine at 24 mg/mL HA and supplied as pre-filled syringes.
